To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a new image denoise method based on adaptive modeling of image patches in transform domain, (2) the distribution of each patch is modeled based on non-local similar patches, (3) adaptive soft-threshold is employed to regularize the patch based on its modeled distribution, and (4) the performance is evaluated in both objective and subjective measures.

1) the proposed method can improve the image quality by employing adaptive signal modeling and soft-thresholding; 2) the proposed method is robust to noise; 3) the proposed method outperforms the current state-of-the-art image denoising methods in terms of both the objective and subjective quality.
